veld-ps-rondo-3-1.uitleg: Three players keep the ball in a triangle while one player in the middle tries to win it. Whoever loses the ball swaps with the defender in the middle. The outside players move along the lines so they can always receive a pass.
veld-ps-rondo-3-1.organisatie: Triangle with sides of about 10 m (3 disc cones). Three players at the corners, one in the middle wearing a bib. Change the middle player every minute if nobody loses the ball.
coachpunten: Always give two passing options: move away from the defender
Pass to the player the defender isn't screening
Defender: use your body to cut off one passing lane and force the pass the other way

makkelijker: Defender may only intercept, no tackling
moeilijker: Two touches maximum
Smaller triangle (7 m)
One point for 5 passes without losing it; the defender counts interceptions

veld-ps-rondo-3-1.meerSpelers: With 5 players: 4v1 in a square. With 6 or more: a second rondo, or 4v2.

veld-wu-tikkertje-hesjes.uitleg: The tagger holds a bib and tries to tag someone. Whoever is tagged takes the bib and is the new tagger straight away. Running out of the area also counts as being tagged. Play in blocks of 1 to 2 minutes.
veld-wu-tikkertje-hesjes.organisatie: 20 × 20 m area marked with 4 cones. One tagger (two with more than 10 players) holding a bib; everyone else spread out in the area.
coachpunten: Look around and find the space
Small steps when you turn, then accelerate
Tagger: cut off the space instead of chasing someone

makkelijker: The tagger may only skip or move sideways
moeilijker: Smaller area (15 × 15 m)
Two taggers at once
Everyone dribbles a ball; the tagger tags you by knocking your ball out of the area

veld-wu-passen-en-volgen.uitleg: The front player passes to the front player of the opposite line and sprints after the ball, joining the back of that line. The receiver controls the ball and passes it back across. Everyone keeps rotating.
veld-wu-passen-en-volgen.organisatie: Two lines facing each other 10 m apart, each at a cone. Start with the ball at one line. With more than 8 players: two groups side by side.
coachpunten: Pass with the inside of the foot, standing foot next to the ball
Accelerate over the first few metres straight after the pass
Receive with an open body, facing your next pass
Call for the ball: shout the passer's name

moeilijker: One-touch passing
Weaker foot only
Add a second ball from the other line

veld-wu-loopscholing.uitleg: Players take turns going across with a running drill: skipping, running backwards, side-steps, high knees or heel flicks. They jog back easily alongside the lane and rejoin the back of the queue. Change the drill every round.
veld-wu-loopscholing.organisatie: 12 m lane between two cones. Players queue behind the start cone. The next player goes when the one in front is about 4 m away.
coachpunten: Stay on the balls of your feet, not your heels
Drive the arms (90° at the elbow)
Upright trunk, hips high
Jog back easily: that's your recovery

moeilijker: After 6 m, go from the running drill into a sprint
Backwards while looking over your shoulder
Side-steps with arms crossing above your head
At the end of the lane, control a ball from the coach and pass it back

veld-wu-rondo-4-1.uitleg: Four players on the sides of the square keep the ball; the player in the middle tries to win it. Whoever loses the ball or plays it out goes in the middle. A pass through the middle (between the lines) counts double.
veld-wu-rondo-4-1.organisatie: 8 × 8 m square. One player on each side, one player in the middle wearing a bib. Change the middle player every 60–90 seconds if nobody loses the ball.
coachpunten: Stay open: receive on your back foot so you can go either way
Move along your line to stay available
Pass to your teammate's correct foot
Defender: press and use your body to cut off a passing lane

makkelijker: The defender may only intercept, no challenges
moeilijker: Two touches maximum
Smaller square (6 × 6 m)
4v2 in a 10 × 10 m square
After six passes, a through ball to a player who sprints out of the square and shoots at a mini goal

veld-wu-rondo-4-1.meerSpelers: With 6 players: 4v2. With more: a second rondo.

veld-wu-dribbelen-opdrachten.uitleg: Everyone dribbles their own ball around the area. When the coach calls a command, you do it: "turn" (take the ball the other way), "stop" (sole on the ball) or "swap" (leave your ball and take another one).
veld-wu-dribbelen-opdrachten.organisatie: 15 × 15 m area. Every player has a ball. The coach stands at the side and calls the commands.
coachpunten: Ball close to your feet: a touch every step or every other step
Look up between touches, not only at the ball
Use the inside and outside, left and right foot
Accelerate straight after the turn

moeilijker: Smaller area (10 × 10 m)
Weaker foot only
Colours as commands (red = cut, blue = step-over)
The coach tries to knock balls away
On the whistle, dribble to one of four mini goals and score

veld-wu-schatrovers.uitleg: On the signal both teams run to the middle area and dribble one ball at a time back to their own area. Once the middle is empty, you may raid a ball from the other team's area. After 1 minute, the team with the most balls wins.
veld-wu-schatrovers.organisatie: 4 × 4 m middle area with 5 or more balls. Two home areas of 3 × 6 m, 8 m to the left and right of the middle. Two teams of 2–5 players, each at their own area.
coachpunten: Decide quickly: which ball do I go for?
Short dribble with lots of touches, look up
Talk to your team: who raids and who collects from the middle?

makkelijker: No raiding from the other team
moeilijker: One player per team may defend their own area
Dribble with the weaker foot only
Home areas further away

veld-wu-spiegelen.uitleg: Two players face each other, each between two disc cones. The leader moves sideways, forwards or backwards; the follower copies them as quickly as possible like a mirror image. Swap after 20 seconds.
veld-wu-spiegelen.organisatie: For each pair, two 8 m lines (disc cones at the ends) 4 m apart. Both players start in the middle of their line.
coachpunten: Low centre of gravity, on the balls of your feet
Sideways: don't cross your feet
Follower: watch your partner's hips, not their head

moeilijker: The leader may use feints
First to the disc cone scores a point
With a ball at your feet
After the mirroring the coach plays a ball in: 1v1 on two mini goals

veld-wu-lopend-passen.naam: Passing on the move in pairs
veld-wu-lopend-passen.uitleg: Two players jog side by side to the far end, passing the ball to each other as they go. Always play the ball in front of your partner so they can take it in their stride. Turn round at the end and come back.
veld-wu-lopend-passen.organisatie: 25 m long lane; players 6 m apart. Cones at the start and end of both lines. Several pairs side by side works fine.
coachpunten: Play the ball in front of your partner, in their running direction
Take your first touch forwards, don't stop
Steady pace: it's a warm-up

moeilijker: One-touch passing
Pass with the outside of the foot
10 m apart, or return a thrown ball with your laces
Finish with a shot at a mini goal at the end of the lane

veld-wu-overlopertje.uitleg: All players stand on the start line, the tagger in the middle. On the signal everyone runs to the other side without being tagged. Whoever is tagged becomes a tagger too. Keep going until one player is left: they are the winner.
veld-wu-overlopertje.organisatie: 20 × 16 m area. Runners on one short line, one tagger (in a bib) in the middle. After each crossing, wait until everyone is ready.
coachpunten: Look ahead and find the gaps between the taggers
Accelerate and change direction at the right moment
Taggers: work together and close the space as a group

moeilijker: Runners dribble a ball; a tag = knocking the ball out of the area
Narrower area
Taggers hold hands (chain tag)

veld-cv-circuit-drie-stations.uitleg: Three stations side by side, with one player (or a small group) working at each. Station 1: over the hurdles. Station 2: slalom dribble through the cones. Station 3: two passes against the rebounder. Then everyone moves on one station.
veld-cv-circuit-drie-stations.organisatie: Three 10 m lanes, 10 m apart. With bigger groups, a queue at each station. 45 seconds per station, then rotate to the right; the last player runs round the outside back to station 1.
coachpunten: Hurdles: knees high, short ground contact
Slalom: small touches, alternating left and right
Rebounder: inside of the foot, take your first touch towards the next pass

moeilijker: Fourth station: shooting at a mini goal
Against the clock: who gets the most reps?
Everything with the weaker foot
